cod_rationale: IA signed Mar 2025, financial security not posted (NTP not given as of Jun 2026). BESS build is 12-18 months from NTP. With NTP needed ~immediately to hit May 2027, and no evidence of active development (no EPC, no financing PR, no construction start), a 2027 COD requires NTP by late 2026. The developer has no public track record. The unexplained COD pull-back (2028-04 → 2027-05 in one update) adds uncertainty rather than reducing it — no new milestone achieved coincided with that acceleration. Independent estimate 2028-Q2 (assuming NTP mid-2027 + 12-month build); high drift risk. Project is real but early-stage.
